{{Quote|Preparing to drop out of light speed.''"<br />"''Nice flying, ''Wedge''. Right on target.''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Whoah''! Much closer and we wouldn't need a docking clamp.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Drone Alone">{{SWComicCite|7.10|Drone Alone}}</ref>}}
A '''docking clamp''' or '''docking claw''' was a device that [[Starship/Legends|starships]] used to attach themselves to other ships as a means for ships to latch onto one another, many times for boarding or for goods transfer purposes.

Docking clamps were capable of attaching themselves to another starship through mechanical and magnetic means, securely enough that the tremendous forces of [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] was not enough to dislodge the other ship. These features were often taken advantage of by customs patrol ships, such as the [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrives]] [[Imperial Customs Corvette|Imperial customs corvette]], for boarding action purposes, as well as by The [[Sabertooth-class assault/rescue vessel|''Sabertooth''-class assault/rescue vessels]], which used docking clamps and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] grappling systems to forcibly move starships off the battlefield.

In a famous example during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon's'']] docking clamp to hide the ship on an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].

The [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defender]] was equipped with multiple docking clamps, allowing it to dock with multiple [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] simultaneously, making it one of the largest known ships to have docking clamps.

The [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] was among the vessels to be equipped with docking clamps.
